name: opencob
description: Open-Source AI Coding Assistant — Privacy-First, Legacy-Ready

enumDescriptions: Local Ollama server — fully private, no data leaves your machine
LiteLLM proxy — unified gateway to route to any LLM backend
OpenAI API — GPT-4o, GPT-5, o1, o3, etc.
Azure OpenAI Service — enterprise-grade with managed deployment
Anthropic API — Claude Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5, Opus 4
Google Gemini API — Gemini 2.5 Flash and Pro
Any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint (vLLM, text-gen-webui, etc.)
OpenCob.model.provider.markdownDescription:
Which LLM provider to use for inference. Only the settings for the selected provider are relevant.

**Quick start:**
- Local/private → `ollama`
- Corporate proxy → `litellm`
- Direct cloud API → `openai` / `azure` / `anthropic` / `gemini`

OpenCob.model.chat.markdownDescription:
Model for **chat interactions** (agentic coding, Q&A, refactoring).

Click the model name in the status bar or run `OpenCob: Select Model` to browse available models.

**Examples by provider:**
| Provider | Models |
|----------|--------|
| Ollama | `qwen2.5-coder:7b`, `deepseek-coder:6.7b` |
| LiteLLM | `azure/gpt-5-mini-EU`, `anthropic-vertex-claude-sonnet-4-5` |
| OpenAI | `gpt-4o`, `o1`, `gpt-5` |
| Anthropic | `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250514` |
| Gemini | `gemini-2.5-flash`, `gemini-2.5-pro` |

OpenCob.model.completion.markdownDescription:
Model for **inline code completion** (FIM / ghost text). Should be a fast, small model for low latency.

**Examples by provider:**
| Provider | Models |
|----------|--------|
| Ollama | `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b`, `starcoder2:3b` |
| LiteLLM | `azure/gpt-5-nano-EU` |
| OpenAI | `gpt-4o-mini` |
| Anthropic | `claude-haiku-4-5-20250514` |
| Gemini | `gemini-2.5-flash` |

OpenCob.model.embedding.markdownDescription:
Model for **text embeddings** (workspace indexing & semantic search).

**Examples:** `nomic-embed-text`, `text-embedding-3-small`, `mxbai-embed-large`

OpenCob.ollama.baseUrl.markdownDescription:
Ollama server URL. **Only used when provider is `ollama`.**

Start Ollama with `ollama serve` before using.

OpenCob.litellm.baseUrl.markdownDescription:
LiteLLM proxy URL. **Only used when provider is `litellm`.**

LiteLLM acts as a unified proxy to route requests to any backend (Azure, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, etc.).

OpenCob.litellm.apiKey.markdownDescription: Bearer token for authenticating with the LiteLLM proxy. Leave empty if your proxy doesn’t require auth.

OpenCob.openai.baseUrl.markdownDescription: OpenAI API base URL. **Only used when provider is `openai`.**

OpenCob.openai.apiKey.markdownDescription: Your OpenAI API key. Get one at [platform.openai.com/api-keys](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys).

OpenCob.azure.baseUrl.markdownDescription:
Azure OpenAI endpoint. **Only used when provider is `azure`.**

Format: `https://{resource-name}.openai.azure.com`

OpenCob.azure.apiKey.markdownDescription: Azure OpenAI API key from your Azure Portal resource.

OpenCob.anthropic.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Anthropic API base URL. **Only used when provider is `anthropic`.**

OpenCob.anthropic.apiKey.markdownDescription: Your Anthropic API key. Get one at [console.anthropic.com](https://console.anthropic.com/).

OpenCob.gemini.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Gemini OpenAI-compatible endpoint. **Only used when provider is `gemini`.**

OpenCob.gemini.apiKey.markdownDescription: Your Google AI API key. Get one at [aistudio.google.com/apikey](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey).

OpenCob.openaiCompatible.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL for any OpenAI-compatible server (vLLM, text-generation-webui, LocalAI, etc.). **Only used when provider is `openai-compatible`.**

OpenCob.openaiCompatible.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key for your custom endpoint (leave empty if not required).

OpenCob.inlineCompletion.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable **inline code completion** (ghost text suggestions as you type).

OpenCob.inlineCompletion.debounceMs.markdownDescription: Delay (ms) after you stop typing before requesting a completion. Lower = faster but more API calls.

OpenCob.inlineCompletion.maxPrefixChars.markdownDescription: Max characters of code **before** the cursor sent to the completion model (~4 chars ≈ 1 token).

OpenCob.inlineCompletion.maxSuffixChars.markdownDescription: Max characters of code **after** the cursor sent to the completion model.

OpenCob.inlineCompletion.maxCrossFileCha.markdownDescription: Max characters from other open files included as cross-file context for better completions.

OpenCob.contextWindow.maxTokens.markdownDescription: Max context window size (tokens) for chat interactions. Increase for larger codebases; decrease to save costs.

OpenCob.autoApprove.read.markdownDescription: Auto-approve **read** tool calls (file reads, searches) without prompting.

OpenCob.autoApprove.edit.markdownDescription: Auto-approve **file edit** tool calls without prompting. ⚠️ Use with caution.

OpenCob.autoApprove.command.markdownDescription: Auto-approve **terminal command** execution without prompting. ⚠️ Use with caution.

OpenCob.enterprise.serverUrl.markdownDescription:
OpenCob Enterprise server URL for team features (telemetry, shared context, policy).

Example: `https://opencob-ee.company.com`

OpenCob.enterprise.token.markdownDescription: Auth token for Enterprise server. Auto-set when using `OpenCob: Connect to Enterprise Server` command.
